replacing_dissenter_without_replan.observed_error: Resolve the previous dissent in its debate, or explicitly replan with a recorded reason before opening another.

veto_blocks_consensus.observed_error: Unresolved dissent or different selected approaches prevent consensus. Keep objections and resolve them explicitly.

revoked_capability_before_open.observed_error: An assigned agent no longer declares its required capability.

audit.integrity_limit: Local consistency check; the hash chain is not authenticated against a trusted external anchor.

same_plan_revision_bypasses_dissent.observed_error: Retain dissent and use explicit task replan with a resolution reason before replacing the plan.

veto_after_earlier_consensus.observed_error: Independent review requested changes; resolve or rework the proposal.
